intro.en: A reading passage about the bond between Islam and the Arabic language: the Quran was revealed in Arabic, and Islam carried Arabic to many lands and peoples.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka matan hai jo Islam aur Arabi zubaan ke rishte ke bare mein hai: Quran Arabi mein nazil hua aur Islam ne Arabi ko bahut se mulkon aur qaumon tak pohanchaya.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنِ الصِّلَةِ بَيْنَ الإِسْلامِ وَاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ: نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ، وَحَمَلَ الإِسْلامُ العَرَبِيَّةَ إِلى بُلْدانٍ وَشُعوبٍ كَثيرَةٍ.

dialogue.ar: نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ الكَريمُ بِلُغَةِ العَرَبِ، فَقامَ بَيْنَهُما ارْتِباطٌ وَثيقٌ لا يَنْفَصِلُ.
dialogue.tr: nazala l-qurʾānul-karīmu bi-lughatil-ʿarab, fa-qāma baynahumā irtibāṭun wathīqun lā yanfaṣil
dialogue.en: The Noble Quran came down in the language of the Arabs, so a firm, inseparable bond formed between them.
dialogue.ur: Quran-e-Kareem Arabon ki zubaan mein nazil hua, to dono ke darmiyan ek mazboot aur na-qabil-e-judai rishta ban gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَلَيْسَ في الكُتُبِ السَّماوِيَّةِ كِتابٌ حُفِظَ بِلُغَتِهِ الأُولى كَما حُفِظَ القُرْآنُ.
dialogue.tr: wa laysa fil-kutubis-samāwiyyati kitābun ḥufiẓa bi-lughatihil-ūlā kamā ḥufiẓal-qurʾān
dialogue.en: Among the heavenly books there is none preserved in its first language as the Quran has been.
dialogue.ur: Aasmani kitabon mein koi kitab apni pehli zubaan mein is tarah mehfooz nahi rahi jaise Quran mehfooz hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِذلِكَ تَنْقُلُ التَّرْجَمَةُ مَعانِيَهُ فَقَطْ، أَمّا نَصُّهُ المُقَدَّسُ فَلا يُبَدَّلُ.
dialogue.tr: wa li-dhālika tanqulut-tarjamatu maʿānīhi faqaṭ, ammā naṣṣuhul-muqaddasu fa-lā yubaddal
dialogue.en: So translation carries only its meanings, while its sacred text is never changed.
dialogue.ur: Isliye tarjuma sirf uske maani muntaqil karta hai, jabke uska muqaddas matan badla nahi jata.

dialogue.ar: يَتْلوهُ المُسْلِمونَ في صَلَواتِهِمْ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ، فَهُوَ كَلامٌ تَعَبُّدِيٌّ يَتَقَرَّبونَ بِهِ إِلى اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: yatlūhul-muslimūna fī ṣalawātihim bil-ʿarabiyyah, fa-huwa kalāmun taʿabbudiyyun yataqarrabūna bihi ilā llāh
dialogue.en: Muslims recite it in their prayers in Arabic; it is words of worship by which they draw near to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Musalman namaz mein ise Arabi mein padhte hain; yeh ibadat ka kalaam hai jis se woh Allah ka qurb chahte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ المُعْجِزَةُ الخالِدَةُ الَّتي تَحَدّى اللهُ بِها أَهْلَ البَلاغَةِ في كُلِّ زَمَنٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa huwal-muʿjizatul-khālidatul-latī taḥaddā llāhu bihā ahlal-balāghati fī kulli zaman
dialogue.en: It is the everlasting miracle with which Allah challenged the masters of eloquence in every age.
dialogue.ur: Yeh woh hamesha rehne wala moajiza hai jis se Allah ne har zamane ke ahl-e-balaghat ko chunauti di.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَحَبَّ العُلَماءُ هذِهِ اللُّغَةَ وَبَذَلوا جُهوداً كَبيرَةً في خِدْمَتِها وَحِفْظِ قَواعِدِها.
dialogue.tr: wa qad aḥabbal-ʿulamāʾu hādhihil-lughata wa badhalū juhūdan kabīratan fī khidmatihā wa ḥifẓi qawāʿidihā
dialogue.en: Scholars loved this language and made great efforts to serve it and preserve its rules.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ne is zubaan se mohabbat ki aur iski khidmat aur qawaid ki hifazat mein bari koshishein kin.

dialogue.ar: فَأُلِّفَتْ كُتُبُ النَّحْوِ وَالمُعْجَماتُ، وَكانَتْ تِلْكَ ثَمَراتٍ طَيِّبَةً لِهذا الارْتِباطِ المُبارَكِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-ullifat kutubun-naḥwi wal-muʿjamāt, wa kānat tilka thamarātin ṭayyibatan li-hādhal-irtibāṭil-mubārak
dialogue.en: Books of grammar and dictionaries were written, and those were good fruits of this blessed bond.
dialogue.ur: Nahv ki kitabein aur lughaat likhe gaye, aur yeh is mubarak rishte ke achhe phal the.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ انْتَشَرَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ خارِجَ بِلادِها بَعْدَ الفَتْحِ، وَوَصَلَتْ إِلى بُلْدانٍ بَعيدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: thumma ntasharatil-ʿarabiyyatu khārija bilādihā baʿdal-fatḥ, wa waṣalat ilā buldānin baʿīdah
dialogue.en: Then Arabic spread beyond its own lands after the conquests and reached distant countries.
dialogue.ur: Phir fatuhaat ke baad Arabi apne mulk se bahar phaili aur door door ke mulkon tak pahunchi.

dialogue.ar: فَدَخَلَتْ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ في الإِسْلامِ، وَتَعَلَّمَتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ لِتَقْرَأَ كِتابَ رَبِّها.
dialogue.tr: fa-dakhalat shuʿūbun kathīratun fil-islām, wa taʿallamatil-ʿarabiyyata li-taqraʾa kitāba rabbihā
dialogue.en: Many peoples entered Islam and learned Arabic to read the book of their Lord.
dialogue.ur: Bahut si qaumein Islam mein dakhil huin aur apne Rab ki kitab padhne ke liye Arabi seekhi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَصْبَحَتْ لُغَةَ العِلْمِ وَالإِدارَةِ في دُوَلٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ، وَقامَتْ بِها حَضارَةٌ عَظيمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa aṣbaḥat lughatal-ʿilmi wal-idārati fī duwalin mukhtalifah, wa qāmat bihā ḥaḍāratun ʿaẓīmah
dialogue.en: It became the language of knowledge and administration in various states, and a great civilization arose through it.
dialogue.ur: Woh mukhtalif mulkon mein ilm aur intizam ki zubaan ban gayi aur uske zariye ek azeem tehzeeb qaim hui.

dialogue.ar: وَما زالَ المُسْلِمونَ في أَنْحاءِ العالَمِ يُعَلِّمونَ أَبْناءَهُمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ، وَهذا نَشْرٌ لَها وَحِفْظٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa mā zālal-muslimūna fī anḥāʾil-ʿālami yuʿallimūna abnāʾahumul-ʿarabiyyah, wa hādhā nashrun lahā wa ḥifẓ
dialogue.en: Muslims around the world still teach their children Arabic, and this is spreading and preserving it.
dialogue.ur: Duniya bhar ke musalman ab bhi apne bachchon ko Arabi sikhate hain, aur yeh uski ishaat aur hifazat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الدُّعاةُ يَتَعَلَّمونَها لِيُبَلِّغوا الدَّعْوَةَ إِلى النّاسِ بِلِسانٍ يَفْهَمونَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānad-duʿātu yataʿallamūnahā li-yuballighud-daʿwata ilan-nāsi bi-lisānin yafhamūnah
dialogue.en: Callers to Islam would learn it to convey the message to people in a tongue they understood.
dialogue.ur: Dai us ko seekhte the taake logon tak dawat aisi zubaan mein pohnchayein jo woh samajhte hon.

dialogue.ar: وَهكَذا حَمَلَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ رِسالَةَ الإِسْلامِ إِلى العالَمِ، وَبَقِيَتْ لُغَةَ الوَحْيِ وَالعِبادَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa hākadhā ḥamalatil-ʿarabiyyatu risālatal-islāmi ilal-ʿālam, wa baqiyat lughatal-waḥyi wal-ʿibādah
dialogue.en: Thus Arabic carried the message of Islam to the world and remained the language of revelation and worship.
dialogue.ur: Yun Arabi ne Islam ka paigham duniya tak pohnchaya aur wahi aur ibadat ki zubaan bani rahi.

q.en: What is the language of the Quran?
q.ur: Quran ki zubaan kaunsi hai?

q.en: According to the text, what happened to Arabic after the conquests?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq fatuhaat ke baad Arabi ke saath kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ لِلُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ بَعْدَ الفَتْحِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: It was replaced by another language

q.en: What does a translation carry, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq tarjuma kya muntaqil karta hai?

q.en: In many states Arabic became the language of...
q.ur: Kai mulkon mein Arabi kis ki zubaan ban gayi?
q.ar: أَصْبَحَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ في دُوَلٍ كَثيرَةٍ لُغَةَ...

intro.en: The diminutive (التَّصْغير) makes a noun small or shows affection. A three-letter word follows the pattern فُعَيْل, e.g. قَلْب becomes قُلَيْب. Four-letter words follow فُعَيْعِل, e.g. مَنْزِل becomes مُنَيْزِل. Five-letter words with a long vowel follow فُعَيْعيل, e.g. عُصْفور becomes عُصَيْفير.
intro.ur: Tasgheer ka matlab kisi naam ko chhota ya pyara banana hai. Teen harf wale lafz ka wazn فُعَيْل hai, jaise قَلْب se قُلَيْب. Chaar harf wale ka wazn فُعَيْعِل hai, jaise مَنْزِل se مُنَيْزِل. Aur madd wale paanch harf wale ka wazn فُعَيْعيل hai, jaise عُصْفور se عُصَيْفير.
intro.ar: التَّصْغيرُ يَجْعَلُ الاسْمَ صَغيرًا أَوْ يُفيدُ التَّحَبُّبَ. الثُّلاثِيُّ عَلى وَزْنِ «فُعَيْل» مِثْلُ قَلْب: قُلَيْب، وَالرُّباعِيُّ عَلى «فُعَيْعِل» مِثْلُ مَنْزِل: مُنَيْزِل، وَما فيهِ حَرْفُ مَدٍّ عَلى «فُعَيْعيل» مِثْلُ عُصْفور: عُصَيْفير.

q.en: What is the diminutive of قَلْب (heart)?
q.ur: قَلْب ki tasgheer kya hai?

q.en: What is the diminutive of مَنْزِل (house)?
q.ur: مَنْزِل ki tasgheer kya hai?

q.en: The diminutive of عُصْفور (sparrow) is...
q.ur: عُصْفور ki tasgheer hai...

q.en: What is the pattern of the diminutive of a three-letter word?
q.ur: Teen harfi lafz ki tasgheer ka wazn kya hai?

title.en: Listening (1): The Story of the Revelation
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (1): Wahi ka waqia

intro.en: Listen to the story of how the revelation began, told by Khadijah, then mark each statement true or false. The first verses of the Quran called people to knowledge.
intro.ur: Wahi ke shuru hone ka waqia suniye, jise Sayyida Khadijah (RA) bayan karti hain, phir har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat nishan kijiye. Quran ki pehli aayaat ilm ki taraf bulati hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى قِصَّةِ بِدايَةِ الوَحْيِ كَما رَوَتْها خَديجَةُ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْها، ثُمَّ حَدِّدْ كُلَّ عِبارَةٍ صَوابًا أَوْ خَطَأً. دَعَتِ الآياتُ الأولى مِنَ القُرْآنِ النّاسَ إِلى العِلْمِ.

q.en: Who narrates the story of the revelation in the exercise?
q.ur: Mashq mein wahi ka waqia kaun bayan karta hai?
q.ar: مَنْ تَروي قِصَّةَ الوَحْيِ في التَّمْرينِ؟

q.en: How did the revelation begin?
q.ur: Wahi ka aaghaz kaise hua?

q.en: What did the first three verses of the Quran call people to?
q.ur: Quran ki pehli teen aayaat kis ki taraf bulati hain?
q.ar: إِلى ماذا دَعَتِ الآياتُ الثَّلاثُ الأولى مِنَ القُرْآنِ؟

q.en: The exercise asks: Waraqah ibn Nawfal knew which two languages?
q.ur: Mashq ke mutabiq Waraqah ibn Nawfal kaun si do zubaanein jaante the?
q.ar: يَسْأَلُ التَّمْرينُ: ما اللُّغَتانِ اللَّتانِ كانَ يَعْرِفُهُما وَرَقَةُ بْنُ نَوْفَلٍ؟

title.en: Listening (2): Features of the Message of Muhammad
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (2): Risalat-e-Muhammadi ki khusoosiyat

intro.en: Listen to a text about what makes the message of Muhammad ﷺ special, then judge the statements. The unit also includes a speaking drill: discuss either-or topics with a classmate.
intro.ur: Ek matan suniye jo Muhammad ﷺ ki risalat ki khusoosiyat ke bare mein hai, phir jumlon ko parkhiye. Is sabaq mein guftagu ki mashq bhi hai: 'ya yeh ya woh' mauzoo par saathi se baat kijiye.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ خَصائِصِ رِسالَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى العِباراتِ. وَفي الوَحْدَةِ أَيْضًا تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ: ناقِشْ مَعَ زَميلٍ مَوْضوعاتٍ فيها اخْتِيارٌ بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ.

q.en: What does the Arabic word رَسولٌ mean?
q.ur: Arabi lafz رَسولٌ ka kya matlab hai?

options_ar: مَنْ يَنْتَقِلُ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ

q.en: What is the Arabic for 'private sector'?
q.ur: 'Private sector' ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ما القِطاعُ الَّذي تَمْلِكُهُ الشَّرِكاتُ وَالأَفْرادُ لا الحُكومَةُ؟

q.en: What is the meaning of السَّفَرُ?
q.ur: السَّفَرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What is the meaning of العَطاءُ?
q.ur: العَطاءُ ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: The nisba is made by adding ـِيّ (-iyy) at the end of a noun to say a person or thing belongs to it. For example نَجْد (Najd) becomes نَجْدِيّ (from Najd), and عَرَب becomes عَرَبِيّ (Arab). Words ending in ة drop it first: مَكَّة becomes مَكِّيّ.
intro.ur: Nisbat banane ke liye lafz ke aakhir mein ـِيّ lagate hain, taake yeh batayein ke koi cheez ya shakhs us se talluq rakhta hai. Jaise نَجْد se نَجْدِيّ (Najd ka) aur عَرَب se عَرَبِيّ (Arab). Agar lafz ة par khatam ho to pehle ة hata dete hain: مَكَّة se مَكِّيّ.
intro.ar: نَصوغُ النَّسَبَ بِزِيادَةِ «ـِيّ» في آخِرِ الاسْمِ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى الانْتِماءِ إِلَيْهِ، مِثْلُ نَجْد: نَجْدِيّ، وَعَرَب: عَرَبِيّ. وَإِذا كانَ الاسْمُ مُنْتَهِيًا بِالتّاءِ المَرْبوطَةِ حَذَفْناها أَوَّلًا: مَكَّة: مَكِّيّ.

q.en: What is the nisba of عَرَب?
q.ur: عَرَب ki nisbat kya hai?

q.en: What is the nisba of بَغْداد?
q.ur: بَغْداد ki nisbat kya hai?

q.en: What is the nisba of مَكَّة?
q.ur: مَكَّة ki nisbat kya hai?

q.en: What do we add to make a nisba?
q.ur: Nisbat banane ke liye kya lagate hain?

options: ـِيّ at the end of the noun

title.en: Extended Reading: The Man of the Two Gardens
title.ur: Wasee mutalia: Do baghon wala shakhs

intro.en: A story based on Surah al-Kahf (verses 32-44) about two companions. One thanked Allah for his blessings; the other became proud and ungrateful, and lost everything. After the text come questions, exercises and a speaking drill.
intro.ur: Surah al-Kahf (aayat 32 se 44) par mabni ek qissa do saathiyon ke bare mein. Ek ne Allah ki naimaton ka shukr kiya; doosra mutakabbir aur na-shukra ho gaya aur sab kuch kho baitha. Matan ke baad sawalat, mashqein aur guftagu hai.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ مَبْنِيَّةٌ عَلى سورَةِ الكَهْفِ (الآياتُ ٣٢–٤٤) عَنْ صاحِبَيْنِ: شَكَرَ أَحَدُهُما اللهَ عَلى نِعَمِهِ، وَتَكَبَّرَ الآخَرُ وَجَحَدَ فَخَسِرَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ. وَبَعْدَ النَّصِّ أَسْئِلَةٌ وَتَمارينُ وَتَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ.

dialogue.ar: ضَرَبَ اللهُ تَعالى لِلنّاسِ مَثَلاً في سورَةِ الكَهْفِ عَنْ رَجُلَيْنِ أَنْعَمَ عَلَيْهِما بِنِعَمٍ كَثيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: ḍaraba llāhu taʿālā lin-nāsi mathalan fī sūratil-kahfi ʿan rajulayni anʿama ʿalayhimā bi-niʿamin kathīrah
dialogue.en: Allah gave people a parable in Surah al-Kahf about two men upon whom He bestowed many blessings.
dialogue.ur: Allah Taala ne Surah al-Kahf mein logon ke liye ek misaal bayan ki, do aadmiyon ki jin par bahut si naimatein thin.

dialogue.ar: كانَ أَحَدُهُما غَنِيّاً صاحِبَ أَرْضٍ وَأَمْوالٍ، وَالآخَرُ فَقيراً مُؤْمِناً بِاللهِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna aḥaduhumā ghaniyyan ṣāḥiba arḍin wa amwāl, wal-ākharu faqīran muʾminan billāh
dialogue.en: One of them was rich, owner of land and wealth, and the other was poor and a believer in Allah.
dialogue.ur: Un mein se ek ameer tha, zameen aur maal ka malik, aur doosra gareeb aur Allah par iman rakhne wala.

dialogue.ar: جَعَلَ اللهُ لِلغَنِيِّ جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنَ العِنَبِ وَالنَّخيلِ، تَسْقيهِما الأَنْهارُ وَالْيَنابيعُ، وَكانَ لَهُما ثَمَرٌ كَثيرٌ.
dialogue.tr: jaʿala llāhu lil-ghaniyyi jannatayni minal-ʿinabi wan-nakhīl, tasqīhimal-anhāru wal-yanābīʿ, wa kāna lahumā thamarun kathīr
dialogue.en: Allah gave the rich man two gardens of grapes and date palms, watered by rivers and springs, with abundant fruit.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne ameer ko angoor aur khajoor ke do bagh diye, jinhein nahrein aur chashme seraab karte, aur unka phal bahut tha.

dialogue.ar: أَمَّا الفَقيرُ فَكانَ يَشْكُرُ اللهَ عَلى ما عِنْدَهُ، وَيَحْمَدُهُ في كُلِّ حالٍ.
dialogue.tr: ammal-faqīru fa-kāna yashkurullāha ʿalā mā ʿindah, wa yaḥmaduhu fī kulli ḥāl
dialogue.en: As for the poor man, he thanked Allah for what he had and praised Him in every state.
dialogue.ur: Gareeb aadmi jo kuch uske paas tha us par Allah ka shukr karta aur har haal mein uski hamd karta.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمَّا الغَنِيُّ فَكانَ بَخيلاً لا يَرْحَمُ المَساكينَ وَلا يُعْطي الفُقَراءَ.
dialogue.tr: wa ammal-ghaniyyu fa-kāna bakhīlan lā yarḥamul-masākīna wa lā yuʿṭil-fuqarāʾ
dialogue.en: As for the rich man, he was stingy, showing no mercy to the needy and giving nothing to the poor.
dialogue.ur: Ameer kanjoos tha, na miskeenon par raham karta na gareebon ko kuch deta.

dialogue.ar: وَذاتَ يَوْمٍ التَفَتَ إِلى صاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحاوِرُهُ، فَقالَ:
dialogue.tr: wa dhāta yawmin iltafata ilā ṣāḥibihi wa huwa yuḥāwiruh, fa-qāl
dialogue.en: One day he turned to his companion while talking with him and said:
dialogue.ur: Ek din woh apne saathi ki taraf mutawajjah hua, us se baat karte hue kaha:

dialogue.ar: أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا
dialogue.tr: anā aktharu minka mālan wa aʿazzu nafarā
dialogue.en: I have more wealth than you and am stronger in manpower.
dialogue.ur: Main tujh se maal mein zyada aur jatha mein zyada izzat wala hoon.

dialogue.ar: مَا أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِ أَبَدًا
dialogue.tr: mā aẓunnu an tabīda hādhihī abadā
dialogue.en: I do not think this will ever perish.
dialogue.ur: Main nahi samajhta ke yeh kabhi tabah hoga.

dialogue.ar: وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً
dialogue.tr: wa mā aẓunnus-sāʿata qāʾimah
dialogue.en: And I do not think the Hour will ever come.
dialogue.ur: Aur main nahi samajhta ke qayamat qaim hogi.

dialogue.ar: فَأَجابَهُ صاحِبُهُ المُؤْمِنُ ناصِحاً، وَقَدْ رَأى في كَلامِهِ جُحوداً لِنِعَمِ اللهِ:
dialogue.tr: fa-ajābahu ṣāḥibuhul-muʾminu nāṣiḥan, wa qad raʾā fī kalāmihi juḥūdan li-niʿami llāh
dialogue.en: His believing companion answered him with advice, having seen in his words denial of Allah’s blessings:
dialogue.ur: Uske momin saathi ne nasihat ke taur par jawab diya, kyunke us ne uski baat mein Allah ki naimaton ka inkar dekha:

dialogue.ar: أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلًا
dialogue.tr: a-kafarta bil-ladhī khalaqaka min turābin thumma min nuṭfatin thumma sawwāka rajulā
dialogue.en: Have you disbelieved in the One who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then proportioned you as a man?
dialogue.ur: Kya tu ne us zaat ka inkar kiya jis ne tujhe mitti se, phir nutfe se paida kiya, phir tujhe poora aadmi banaya?

dialogue.ar: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
dialogue.tr: wa lawlā idh dakhalta jannataka qulta mā shāʾa llāhu lā quwwata illā billāh
dialogue.en: If only, when you entered your garden, you had said: What Allah wills; there is no power except with Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab tu apne bagh mein dakhil hua to kyun na kaha: Ma shaa Allah, la quwwata illa billah.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّ الغَنِيَّ لَمْ يَقْبَلِ النَّصيحَةَ، وَازْدادَ عِناداً وَغُروراً بِمالِهِ وَأَوْلادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: lākinnal-ghaniyya lam yaqbalin-naṣīḥah, wa zdāda ʿinādan wa ghurūran bi-mālihi wa awlādih
dialogue.en: But the rich man did not accept the advice; he grew more stubborn and proud of his wealth and children.
dialogue.ur: Lekin ameer ne nasihat qubool na ki, balkeh apne maal aur aulad par aur zyada ziddi aur mutakabbir ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ اللهُ عَلى جَنَّتِهِ هَلاكاً، فَضاعَ الثَّمَرُ وَالزَّرْعُ في لَيْلَةٍ واحِدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: fa-arsala llāhu ʿalā jannatihi halākan, fa-ḍāʿath-thamaru waz-zarʿu fī laylatin wāḥidah
dialogue.en: Allah sent destruction upon his garden, and the fruit and crops were lost in a single night.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne uske bagh par tabahi bheji, aur phal aur fasal ek hi raat mein barbad ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَا أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا
dialogue.tr: wa uḥīṭa bi-thamarihi fa-aṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ʿalā mā anfaqa fīhā wa hiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wa yaqūlu yā laytanī lam ushrik bi-rabbī aḥadā
dialogue.en: His fruit was encompassed by ruin, and he began wringing his hands over what he had spent on it, while it lay fallen on its trellises, and he says: If only I had not associated anyone with my Lord.
dialogue.ur: Uska phal ghair liya gaya, to woh us par jo kharch kiya tha haath malne laga jabke woh apni chhaton par gira para tha, aur kehta: Kaash main ne apne Rab ke saath kisi ko shareek na kiya hota.

dialogue.ar: فَنَدِمَ حَيْثُ لا يَنْفَعُ النَّدَمُ، وَعَرَفَ أَنَّ المالَ وَالأَوْلادَ لا يُغْنِيانِ عَنْ شُكْرِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-nadima ḥaythu lā yanfaʿun-nadam, wa ʿarafa annal-māla wal-awlāda lā yughniyāni ʿan shukri llāh
dialogue.en: He regretted when regret no longer helps, and learned that wealth and children cannot replace thanking Allah.
dialogue.ur: Woh us waqt pachhtaya jab pachhtana kaam nahi deta, aur jaan gaya ke maal aur aulad Allah ke shukr se be-niyaz nahi karte.

dialogue.ar: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ  هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا
dialogue.tr: hunālikal-walāyatu lillāhil-ḥaqq, huwa khayrun thawāban wa khayrun ʿuqbā
dialogue.en: There, authority belongs to Allah, the Truth; He is best in reward and best in outcome.
dialogue.ur: Wahan sari hukumat Allah haq ki hai; woh sawab mein bhi behtar hai aur anjaam mein bhi behtar.

q.en: What did Allah give the rich man?
q.ur: Allah ne ameer aadmi ko kya diya?

options: Two gardens with grapes and date palms

q.en: How did the poor believer respond to what he had?
q.ur: Gareeb momin ne jo kuch uske paas tha us par kaisa rad-e-amal diya?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَصَرَّفَ الفَقيرُ المُؤْمِنُ تِجاهَ ما عِنْدَهُ؟

q.en: How did the rich man treat the poor and needy?
q.ur: Ameer ne gareebon aur miskeenon ke saath kaisa sulook kiya?

options: He was stingy and gave them nothing

q.en: What happened to the rich man’s gardens at the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein ameer ke baghon ka kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ لِجَنَّتَيِ الغَنِيِّ في النِّهايَةِ؟

options: They were destroyed in one night
They were given to the poor by him

q.en: What did the believing companion advise him to say on entering his garden?
q.ur: Momin saathi ne bagh mein dakhil hote waqt kya kehne ki nasihat ki?
q.ar: ماذا نَصَحَهُ صاحِبُهُ المُؤْمِنُ أَنْ يَقولَ عِنْدَ دُخولِ جَنَّتِهِ؟

options: ما شاءَ اللهُ لا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ
